data: Which of the lines has the lowest pdf value at x = 0.8?

The question asks which line has the lowest pdf value at x = 0.8. From the caption, we know that the figure shows Zipf plots for two different models: WCFG and PCFG. The y-axis represents the pdf values, and the x-axis represents rank(o)/T.

Looking at the graph on the left (subfigure (a)), there are multiple lines representing different models. At x = 0.8, the line representing WCFG appears to be below the line representing PCFG. Similarly, looking at the graph on the right (subfigure (b)), the line representing WCFG is also below the line representing PCFG at x = 0.8.

Therefore, the line representing WCFG has the lowest pdf value at x = 0.8 in both graphs.
